channel.title: Crypto Journal
channel.description: Independent crypto news for researchers and analysts, tracking capital flows, protocol revenue, stablecoin supply and the mechanics of digital markets.

item.title: Bitcoin’s Issuance Schedule Reprices Supply, Not Demand
item.description: Bitcoin's halving shows how coded issuance changes miner economics and supply expectations, but demand and market structure still determine price.

item.title: Choose Wrapped Assets by the Claim, Not the Ticker
item.description: A wrapper can represent native collateral, a custodian’s IOU, a bridge claim or staked principal; the real risk sits in the conversion path, not its ticker.

item.title: Check This Metadata Permission Before Buying a Collectible
item.description: Before buying a digital collectible, verify whether its contract lets an owner rewrite the metadata URI, because token ownership cannot preserve the media.

item.title: Matter Labs Opens Prividium Core as Bundesbank Tests It
item.description: Matter Labs opened Prividium’s permissioning core as Germany’s central bank began testing it, cutting vendor lock-in without proving settlement demand.

item.title: Pons Drives Robinhood Chain Fees to $6 Million Record
item.description: Pons-fueled trading pushed Robinhood Chain fees to a $6 million daily record, but falling active accounts expose a concentrated, reflexive boom.

item.title: Wyoming Puts FRNT Reserve Checks Onchain With Chainlink
item.description: Wyoming’s Chainlink integration makes FRNT backing machine-readable, tightening issuance controls without proving that users want the state-issued token.

item.title: Matter Labs Opens Prividium Core as Bundesbank Begins Test
item.description: Matter Labs removed a vendor-lock-in barrier for institutional ZK chains, but the Bundesbank test adds no live volume or new economics to ZKsync.

item.title: Hyperliquid Open Interest Returns to $14.3 Billion
item.description: Hyperliquid’s $14.3 billion in open interest restores its pre-crash scale, but a shift back to core crypto markets matters more for HYPE economics.

item.title: Visa’s Onchain Credit Moves Card Settlement Into Smart Contracts
item.description: Visa’s settlement-financing model turns card receivables into smart-contract collateral, cutting idle capital while moving execution risk onchain.

item.title: Pons pushes Robinhood Chain fees to a $6 million record
item.description: Pons drove Robinhood Chain fees to $6 million in a day, but falling active accounts show repeat speculation—not wider adoption—powered the record.
